record.description: QuickBooks API allows developers to create apps that interact with QuickBooks company data, including company info, using OAuth tokens for authorization.
record.api_breadth: The API supports accessing company information and other QuickBooks data endpoints, with SDKs available for multiple languages including DotNet, Java, and PHP.

evidence.claim: QuickBooks API allows developers to create apps that interact with QuickBooks company data, including company info, using OAuth tokens for authorization.
evidence.quote: Create a developer account Create an app Generate OAuth tokens using playround Make the API call - click to see the curl request curl -X GET 'https://sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/company id/companyinfo/company id/?minorversion=12' -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'authorization: Bearer accesstoken' -H 'content-type: application/json'
